message.content:
An illustration serves as a magazine cover with the red title "TEMPO" across the top. The background is a solid red field. In the foreground and middle ground, three giant figures are shown from the waist down. On the left, a figure wears dark blue trousers and black shoes. In the center, another figure wears royal blue trousers and black shoes. On the right, a figure wears black trousers and dark gray slip-on shoes with white soles.

In the center of these giant legs stands a tiny, man-sized figure. He wears a white short-sleeved button-down shirt with small insignias, a black belt, and black trousers. He holds a light blue folder under his left arm and looks upward with his right hand raised toward his forehead.

Legible text includes "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU," "Musim Ambles Investasi Kripto H.84," and "Harimau Penangkaran Pertama di Alam Liar H.98." At the bottom right, large white text reads "PAHIT-MANIS ANIES," followed by a paragraph of smaller white Indonesian text ending with "H.20." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right corner.
